carte.title: A short menu, all homemade
carte.intro: Pick your base, then your filling and your sauce. That's it, on purpose.
carte.vegeIntro: Five-spice tofu replaces the meat in every bánh mì and every bún. Say “vegan” when you order and we'll adapt the sauce and toppings.
carte.allergens: Allergens: peanut, soy, gluten (bread, sauces), egg (cà phê trứng). Just ask and we'll go through each dish with you.

story.title: Ở nhà, “at home”
story.p1: ONHA comes from “ở nhà”, which means “at home” in Vietnamese. That's exactly what we cook: our family's dishes, street-food style.
story.p2: Behind the counter on rue Saint-Leu, we're two brothers. The pickles, sauces and marinades are made here every day, and the menu stays short so everything is fresh.
story.p3: Here, we take our time. Coffee drips slowly through its phin, the dish of the day changes every morning, and we're happy to tell you what's in your bowl.

infos.title: Rue Saint-Leu, by the water
infos.accessText: In the heart of the Saint-Leu quarter, a few minutes' walk from the cathedral and the banks of the Somme. The quarter is best explored on foot: park in the city centre.
infos.services: Eat in · Takeaway · Card · Mobile payment

items.q: Do you have vegetarian and vegan dishes?
items.a: Yes. Every bánh mì and every bún comes with five-spice tofu if you like. Ask for the vegan version when you order and we'll adapt the sauce and toppings. There's also a vegan bò bún and a tofu bowl.

Our dishes may contain peanuts (peanut sauce, topping), soy (sauces, tofu) and gluten (bánh mì bread, some sauces). The egg coffee contains egg. Tell us about your allergy when you order and we'll tell you exactly what's in each dish.
Use the form on this site: choose your dishes and a pick-up time, and we'll cook. You can also call +33 9 87 18 79 29 during service, or just come to the counter.
At the counter, by card or mobile payment. There's no online payment.

items.q: Are you open in the evening?
items.a: Lunch Monday to Saturday, 11:30 am to 1:30 pm. Evenings on Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, 6:30 pm to 8:30 pm. Closed on Sunday.
Yes, in a modern, quiet dining room. At lunchtime, come early or order takeaway to skip the wait.
